status_summary: EO 14332 (signed 2025-08-07) directed the OMB Director to revise the Uniform Guidance (2 CFR part 200) to require termination-for-convenience in discretionary grants and to limit facilities and administrative costs. OMB, with 43 co-signing agencies and offices, published a proposed rule on 2026-05-29 (Regulation for Federal Financial Assistance) that would revise part 200 broadly; comments closed 2026-07-13, and a law firm analysis reports an intended effective date of 2026-10-01 and that OMB declined to address indirect cost rates in this rulemaking. No final rule was found as of 2026-10-10, so nothing is yet operative. No OMB action on the Information Quality Act, Paperwork Reduction Act or Privacy Act was found.

title: Revise the Uniform Guidance for grants and strengthen information-policy statutes
uncertainties: The proposed rule text was read only through its opening sections and table of contents; its proposed effective date section was not reached. The intended effective date comes from a law firm alert, not OMB. Federal Register API queries (researcher and reviewer reruns) found no final rule through 2026-10-10. Searches for OMB memoranda on the Information Quality Act, Paperwork Reduction Act and Privacy Act found nothing after 2025-01-20, so absence there rests on limited searches. Match is partial since the revision serves several purposes beyond EO 12866 alignment.
